name: Ako: A Yandere Love Story
source:
You're in love with Ako, your childhood best friend. But just as you're ready to tell her, an anonymous admirer steps in.

Now the nights are restless, and something feels wrong. Very wrong.

[From [url=https://akogamedev.itch.io/ako-a-yandere-love-story]Itch.io[/url]]
translation:
你爱上了你儿时最好的朋友阿科。但正当你准备告诉她时，一位匿名的崇拜者介入了。

现在夜晚不安宁，感觉有些不对劲。非常错误。
